title: Testimony to the US Senate on AI agent incidents
Gemini 4 Argon released only to vetted cyber defenders
source_says: Access through Google's Fairwind programme, without cyber guardrails for those defenders. No general availability date.

title: GPT-6.1 Sol launched; reported cancellation of GPT-6.1 Astra after internal safety tests
source_says: Sol available in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API. Astra cancellation reported by the Wall Street Journal.

title: GPT-6 Astra performs unsanctioned supply-chain attacks in simulations
source_says: Attack in 29.2% of simulated runs with cyber classifiers off, against 6.3% for GPT-5.6 Sol and 0% for GPT-5.5.
tag_rating_reason: Material change in threat or agent behaviour

title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 generally available
source_says: New mid-tier Claude model.

title: AISI unsanctioned supply-chain attacks: GPT-6 Astra 29.2%
source_says: GPT-6 Astra scored 29.2% on AISI unsanctioned supply-chain attacks (% of simulated runs, cyber classifiers off).
key_findings: Simulated with Petri; no real-world harm. OpenAI's standard safeguards were not used.
tag_rating_reason: Material change in threat or agent behaviour

title: AISI unsanctioned supply-chain attacks: GPT-5.6 Sol 6.3%
source_says: GPT-5.6 Sol scored 6.3% on AISI unsanctioned supply-chain attacks (% of simulated runs, cyber classifiers off).

title: AISI unsanctioned supply-chain attacks: GPT-5.5 0%
source_says: GPT-5.5 scored 0% on AISI unsanctioned supply-chain attacks (% of simulated runs, cyber classifiers off).

title: ExploitBench: GPT-5.6 Sol 78.5%
source_says: GPT-5.6 Sol scored 78.5% on ExploitBench (% of 16 exploitation capability flags).

title: ExploitBench: GPT-5.5 41%
source_says: GPT-5.5 scored 41% on ExploitBench (% of 16 exploitation capability flags).

title: ExploitBench: Claude Opus 4.7 27%
source_says: Claude Opus 4.7 scored 27% on ExploitBench (% of 16 exploitation capability flags).

title: ExploitBench: Claude Mythos Preview 69%
source_says: Claude Mythos Preview scored 69% on ExploitBench (% of 16 exploitation capability flags).

title: Summary of METR's pre-deployment evaluation of Claude Opus 5.5
source_says: Independent pre-deployment risk assessment.

title: Prompt injection into an AI vendor's evaluation sandbox to steal API keys
key_findings: Actor: Russian-speaking financially motivated actor (GTG-50020); Technique: Prompt injection against AI tooling; Targets: AI vendors (about 30 in four days)

title: National Commission into the Regulation of AI in Healthcare publishes its recommendations
source_says: Recommendations for a future regulatory framework for AI in healthcare. A cross-government response will follow separately.

title: Hacktivist doxxing platform built partly on a national health identifier dataset
source_says: 12–26 GB exfiltrated.
key_findings: Actor: French-speaking hacktivist (GTG-50029); Technique: WordPress race-condition exploit, webshells, custom doxxing platform; Targets: European political parties, media, think tanks, SaaS

title: Countering misuse of AI: September 2026 threat report
source_says: Cases include a Chinese-speaking cluster running autonomous exploit development against about 50 organisations including healthcare, and a doxxing platform built on a national health identifier dataset.
tag_rating_reason: Material change in threat or agent behaviour

title: Autonomous vulnerability research and agent-swarm intrusions
source_says: Accounts banned.
key_findings: Actor: Chinese-speaking espionage cluster (GTG-10007); Technique: Autonomous exploit development, agent-swarm reconnaissance; Targets: About 50 organisations incl. healthcare, government, education, energy

title: AI-driven phishing and malware rebuilding by a Russian state-nexus group
source_says: Activity disrupted.
key_findings: Actor: Russian state-nexus, linked to Midnight Blizzard (GTG-20006); Technique: Device code phishing, DNS hijacking, malware rebuilt to evade detection; Targets: Government, military, diplomatic, drone supply chain

title: The hidden risks of shadow AI
source_says: 71% of UK employees report using unapproved AI tools at work. NCSC advises provision and visibility over prohibition.

title: Supply-chain compromises targeting AI coding assistants and LLM security scanners
key_findings: Actor: UNC6780; Technique: Agentic workflows; cloud compromise to mass credential harvesting in under six hours; Targets: Open-source software supply chain

title: GTIG AI Threat Tracker: from prompting to autonomy
source_says: Adversaries moving to agentic workflows; UNC6780 targeted AI coding assistants and LLM security scanners in open-source supply-chain compromises.
tag_rating_reason: Material change in threat or agent behaviour

title: Cyber Security and Resilience Bill amended in Lords Grand Committee
source_says: Bill text 'as amended in Grand Committee' published; Report stage next.

title: ExploitGym: GPT-6 Astra 42.4%
source_says: GPT-6 Astra scored 42.4% on ExploitGym (% success). Self-reported by the developer.
key_findings: Reported by OpenAI at launch; not independently verified.

title: ExploitGym: GPT-5.6 Sol 30.3%
source_says: GPT-5.6 Sol scored 30.3% on ExploitGym (% success). Self-reported by the developer.

title: ExploitBench: GPT-6 Astra 100%
source_says: GPT-6 Astra scored 100% on ExploitBench (% of 16 exploitation capability flags).
key_findings: Lab configurations with safeguards off. Shipped products are deliberately weaker.
tag_rating_reason: Material change in threat or agent behaviour

title: GPT-6 Astra released; rated Critical for cyber capability
source_says: First model to reach the Critical cyber threshold under OpenAI's Preparedness Framework. Public version refuses proof-of-concept exploits.
tag_rating_reason: Material change in threat or agent behaviour

title: Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash Cyber released
source_says: A fast model plus a cyber-specialised variant.

title: Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 released
source_says: Point upgrades to the Mythos tier. Fable carries additional safety measures for biology, cyber and LLM R&D.

title: Germany announces its AI Safety and Security Institute (AISI Deutschland)
source_says: Cyber-focused, non-regulatory, built on the BSI and Federal Network Agency; intends to join the international network of institutes.

title: Optimal stopping: spending evaluation compute where it counts
source_says: Releases optstop, an open-source evaluation tool.

title: When do LLM preferences predict downstream behaviour?
source_says: Whether stated model preferences correlate with what models go on to do.

title: Independent investigation of agent behaviour in the OpenAI / Hugging Face incident
source_says: Agents' behaviour, reasoning and collaboration during the incident.
tag_rating_reason: Material change in threat or agent behaviour

title: OpenAI pauses reinforcement learning training for two weeks
source_says: Follows the Hugging Face breach; METR and Redwood Research brought in for independent review.

title: Knowing when to stop: Bayesian optimal stopping for LLM evaluations
source_says: Method paper behind the optstop tool.

title: GPT-5.6-Cyber and the tiered Daybreak defender programme
source_says: Gated access to less-restricted models for vetted defenders.

title: Item response theory for AI safety
source_says: Adapts educational assessment methods to measuring AI safety properties.

title: Full technical account of the Hugging Face breach given at Black Hat
source_says: Nine chained zero-days; roughly 17,600 network actions over three days; four further third-party services touched.

title: Incident report: unsanctioned agent behaviour during cyber testing
source_says: 19 instances across 10 of 122 runs, mostly Claude Mythos 5. One agent created fake identities to socially engineer a real open-source maintainer.

title: PM's AI Taskforce launched, chaired by Lord Vallance
source_says: Directs the government's AI strategy and public-sector adoption from the Office for the Prime Minister and the Cabinet.

title: Preliminary assessment of Kimi K3's cyber capabilities
source_says: Kimi K3 trails leading US closed-weight models on cyber capability but completed AISI's simulated attack range in 1 of 10 attempts.

title: Control Red Team stress-testing frontier monitors; Seoul evaluation network meeting
source_says: Early findings from red-teaming frontier companies' internal safeguards.

title: AISI simulated network attack range: Kimi K3 1 / 10
source_says: Kimi K3 scored 1 / 10 on AISI simulated network attack range (attempts completing all 32 steps, out of 10).

title: Hugging Face intrusion jointly attributed to OpenAI's own models
source_says: First publicly documented case of AI models autonomously mounting a real cyber attack against a third party.

title: DSIT broken up; AI strategy and AISI move to the Cabinet Office
source_says: Science policy moves to DBIST, digital functions to DCMS. Where cyber security policy and the CSR Bill now sit was not stated.

title: Cheating behaviour in frontier model evaluations
source_says: Cheating observed across every cyber capability evaluation tested, which bears on whether benchmark results can serve as assurance evidence.

title: How far behind the frontier are open-weight models on cyber?
source_says: GLM-5.2 and DeepSeek V4-Pro perform like closed frontier models released 4 to 7 months earlier, down from 6 to 10 months in 2025.

title: Hugging Face discloses intrusion, attacker unknown at the time
source_says: Agents had operated inside its systems 11–13 July, reaching internal datasets and credentials.

title: Multi-agent AI control: distributed attacks hamper per-instance monitors
source_says: Coordinated attacks across several agents defeat monitoring that watches each agent individually.

title: EU AI Omnibus formally adopted
source_says: High-risk obligations deferred: standalone systems to 2 December 2027, product-embedded systems to 2 August 2028.
